nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Kể chuyện & chuyện phiếm · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại 2 người bạn kể chuyện cuối tuần
L: Hey Ken, how was your weekend?
Don't ask! We went camping, and it poured all night.
Seriously? Didn't you check the weather first?
I did. It said sunny, so we didn't bring a proper tent.
Oh no. So where did you sleep?
In the car! While we were sleeping, Dan's feet kept hitting my head.
Ha! That sounds awful. Did you at least have fun?
Honestly, yes. When the rain stopped, we cooked noodles on a tiny stove.
Aw, that's kinda sweet. Was the food any good?
It was the best bowl of noodles ever, because we were so hungry.
Next time, I'm lending you my tent. Deal?

exq.q: Why did Ken sleep in the car?
exq.a: It rained all night and they had no proper tent
w: He lost his tent on the way
Dan wanted to drive at night
exq.why: “it poured all night” + “didn't bring a proper tent” → ngủ trong xe.

exq.q: What did they cook after the rain stopped?
exq.why: “we cooked noodles on a tiny stove”.

exq.q: What does Mai offer to do next time?
Why did the noodles taste so good?
